robot.asset_provenance: pinned SONIC gear_sonic G1 rev 1.0 Dex3 asset (sha256 a7a2bab7), materialized into the data root

table.asset_provenance: Unitree packing table from unitree_sim_assets (Isaac 4.5 Isaac/Props/PackingTable). Variant 2 is used because the PackingTable and PackingTable_1 copies carry a container_h20 resting on the worktop (measured 0.9926-1.0829 m), which would occupy the space the three cubes and the target need.
table.surface_height_provenance: Measured live, not derived. On 2026-09-18 the shipped scene ran against the official SONIC Y controller (planner IDLE, DDS domain 42, Isaac 5.1, headless) and the hand_palm_link world heights settled to 0.67050-0.67079 m (right) and 0.68684-0.68698 m (left) over t=70.4-92.4 s of a 150 s run, and to 0.6628-0.6633 m (right) and 0.6820-0.6821 m (left) over t=32-81 s of a second run. The declared surface is the lowest settled palm of the first run, 0.6706 m (within 8 mm of the second run's lowest palm), so both hands reach the worktop without lowering the torso; the previous 0.7397 m came from forward kinematics of the spawn pose and sat 7 cm above where the policy actually holds the palms. Worktop offset 0.994051 m above the asset origin measured with usd-core BBoxCache over SM_HeavyDutyPackingTable_C02_01 (stage metersPerUnit 0.01) and reproduced in the running stage to 3e-8 m. Verified in the same runs: the cubes rest on the live worktop (live centers 0.6956002 m against the expected 0.6956000 m) and the head camera sees all three cubes and the black target marker. The runtime scene probe reports the live worktop, target and cube heights on every run.
